conoha.vps.autobackup.note: Auto backup (自動バックアップ) by the capacity backed up in GB, hourly billing up to the monthly amount. Tax-inclusive yen as published. Read on the pricing page; ConoHa publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it

conoha.vps.autobackup_generation.note: One backup generation beyond the 14 included (バックアップ世代数拡張), per 100 GB backed up, hourly billing up to the monthly amount. Tax-inclusive yen as published. Read on the pricing page; ConoHa publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it
